A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same study and contain readable main text, equations, 20 figures, two tables, and Appendices A-I. Pagination changes do not prevent reliable content matching.

before.justification: v2 reports original GPT-2 and Mamba experiments, coverage and scaling measurements, representation analyses, and CoT comparisons in Sections 5-8 and the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including the supplementary experiments in Appendices D, E, G, and H.

M1.justification: Appendix C replaces Algorithm 1's Union-Find classes and equal-output input-pair search with direct co-occurrence-based edge construction. Crucially, v3 lines 16-18 add edges only for contexts observed with both fragments, connecting only training examples and making the returned coverage just D. This substantively changes the algorithm as written; corresponding changes to the executed implementation are not established.

E1.justification: Both evaluate 2-HOP, PARALLEL-2-HOP, 3-HOP, NON-TREE, 5-HOP with CoT, and the partial-computation setting. Appendix I's added length-generalization discussion introduces no new evaluated task.

E2.justification: The corresponding experiments retain the same GPT-2 variants, Mamba comparisons, CoT conditions, and partial-computation comparisons. Newly cited methods in Appendix I are not evaluated.

E3.justification: The revised Algorithm 1 changes the prescribed computation underlying coverage percentages and k-cutoff grouping in Section 5 and Appendix H.1. Other experimental settings, including splits, test-set sizes, model configurations, metrics, and generalization thresholds, are retained. The PDFs do not establish that evaluations were rerun.

E4.justification: Causal tracing, token-set and task ablations, partial-computation analysis, hyperparameter robustness, and NON-TREE investigations are retained. Appendix G.3's alternative 0.95-accuracy/10-epoch criterion already appears in v2; its list item is merely moved.

E5.justification: Neither version adds seed counts, repeated-run variability, confidence intervals, or significance tests. Fit-quality reporting and Appendix G.1's threshold-search precision rule remain unchanged; replacing equality with approximate equality for 0.125 is a notation refinement.

E6.justification: The reported result entries and plotted curves are unchanged. Both retain the 96M 2-HOP exponent 2.26 in Table 2, the 3-HOP-CoT exponent 1.76 in Figure 7, and extended-training NON-TREE accuracy 0.96. The algorithm rewrite is not accompanied by revised coverage results.

T1.justification: The defining co-occurrence and consistency conditions, Theorem 6.1's exponent 2.5-0.5/k, and Appendix F's assumptions, bounds, and proofs are retained. Changes concern notation, equation numbering, and clarification of already-assumed uniform sampling.

C1.justification: The abstract and conclusion retain the same contributions: evidence strength predicts generalization, coverage yields sample-complexity bounds, path ambiguity obstructs unified representations, and CoT improves efficiency without eliminating that obstruction. Introduction edits do not materially change their scope.

C2.justification: Interpretations of representation clustering, path ambiguity, CoT, and vocabulary alignment remain unchanged. Appendix A retains the same synthetic-task, sequence-length, and architecture limitations. Appendix I corrects the reversal example's notation without changing its existing interpretation.

D1.justification: Appendix C supplies explicit nested hash-table operations and line-level explanations, while removing v2's disclosures about restricting the graph to training/test inputs and using parallel processing. Appendix B's hyperparameters and hardware, and the reproducibility statement's code-access information, are unchanged.

R1.justification: v3 adds Radford et al. (2018) and six length-generalization references, briefly connecting Appendix I's shared-operator discussion to arithmetic and algorithmic tasks. The broader positioning is retained. The GPT-4 report's changed author attribution refers to the same work.

P1.justification: v3 makes limited main-text copyedits, adds funding acknowledgments, rewrites Appendix C locally, and extends Appendix I briefly. The main narrative, section order, and appendix organization remain intact.

P2.justification: Algorithm 1 gains numbered lines, colored variables, and revised input and stage formatting. Conference headers, bibliography backlinks, and some page-flow adjustments also change. The scientific figures and tables retain their designs and contents.

improvement.justification: The added detail and related-work context are outweighed by a new reproducibility defect in Algorithm 1: its observed-context-only edge loop returns D, whereas v2's routine could connect unseen inputs. This conflicts with Definition 3.2 and the retained held-out coverage results in Figures 3 and 17. The unchanged empirical evidence and proofs limit the decline's scope; the PDFs do not show that the experiments used the faulty revised procedure.
